data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED → GREEN (combined fixture contract test)

Create tests/hooks/test-trailer-format-contract.sh — a fixture test that feeds apply-attribution-trailers.sh output directly to check-sprint-trailer.sh to lock the byte-for-byte format contract.

## Story DD Coverage
- Satisfies story Considerations §1: 'add a fixture test that asserts emitter and validator parse the same trailer string'

## Test Approach

Given:
- A fixture commit message file (can be a temp file)
- A test git repo with a valid DSO_TASK_ID set to a story that has a parent epic (so apply-attribution-trailers.sh produces a DSO-Story trailer)
- OR: a fixture output from apply-attribution-trailers.sh piped to a temp commit msg file

When:
- check-sprint-trailer.sh runs with DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 against the fixture commit (or message file)

Then:
- Exit code 0 (the validator accepts what the emitter produces)

Alternative (if apply-attribution-trailers.sh requires real ticket context): write a known DSO-Story trailer string (matching the exact format from apply-attribution-trailers.sh line 320: 'DSO-Story: <parent_title>') to a fixture commit message and assert the validator accepts it.

## Implementation Notes

- The canonical format is: key='DSO-Story', value=' <parent_story_title>' (note the space after colon, per git interpret-trailers convention)
- Document the format in the test file as a comment citing apply-attribution-trailers.sh:320 as source of truth
- The test must use git interpret-trailers --parse to parse (not grep) — same as the implementation

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- tests/hooks/test-trailer-format-contract.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Test exists at tests/hooks/test-trailer-format-contract.sh and is executable
- [ ] Test verifies that a commit message containing 'DSO-Story: <story title>' passes check-sprint-trailer.sh (exit 0) with DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1
- [ ] Test verifies a commit message WITHOUT DSO-Story trailer fails (exit non-zero) with DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1
- [ ] Format used in test matches exactly: trailer key 'DSO-Story' with standard git interpret-trailers spacing
- [ ] Comment in test cites apply-attribution-trailers.sh as the canonical emitter
- [ ] .test-index updated: entry for tests/hooks/test-trailer-format-contract.sh under plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
data.title: RED+GREEN: Trailer format contract fixture test
